note.pt: Rendimento (yield) medio de 2,5 por craft vale para Processing em nivel Mestre/Guru; ajuste para o seu nivel. Ingrediente com 'any' aceita varios itens: o site usa o mais barato do dia.
note.en: Average yield of 2.5 per craft applies to Master/Guru Processing; adjust for your level. An ingredient with 'any' accepts several items: the site picks the cheapest of the day.

note.pt: Primeiro passo de todo metal: minerio vira fragmento.
note.en: First step for every metal: ore becomes shards.

note.pt: Fragmento vira lingote. A cadeia completa e minerio -> fragmento -> lingote.
note.en: Shards become ingots. The full chain is ore -> shard -> ingot.

note.pt: Liga de ferro com carvao, usada em equipamento e barco.
note.en: Iron and coal alloy, used in gear and ships.

note.pt: Base do latao e do bronze.
note.en: Base for brass and bronze.

note.pt: Usado em ferramentas e moveis.
note.en: Used in tools and furniture.

note.pt: So serve para latao, mas o latao paga bem.
note.en: Only useful for brass, but brass pays well.

note.pt: Intermediario de zinco.
note.en: Zinc intermediate.

note.pt: Liga de cobre e zinco. Costuma ser a mais lucrativa da fundicao.
note.en: Copper and zinc alloy. Usually the most profitable smelt.

note.pt: Base do bronze.
note.en: Base for bronze.

note.pt: Liga de cobre e estanho.
note.en: Copper and tin alloy.

note.pt: Metal nobre, usado em joias e alquimia.
note.en: Precious metal, used in jewelry and alchemy.

note.pt: Caro e de giro lento.
note.en: Expensive and slow to sell.

note.pt: Madeira vira tabua. Toda tabua segue a mesma regra: 5 toras.
note.en: Timber becomes planks. Every plank follows the same rule: 5 timber.

note.pt: Betula costuma ter boa margem por ser menos farmada.
note.en: Birch often has good margin because fewer people farm it.

note.pt: Cedro e das tabuas mais caras.
note.en: Cedar is one of the pricier planks.

note.pt: Usada em barcos e moveis.
note.en: Used in ships and furniture.

note.pt: Volume alto, margem media.
note.en: High volume, average margin.

note.pt: A mais comum; margem costuma ser apertada.
note.en: The most common; margin is usually tight.

note.pt: Madeira de deserto.
note.en: Desert wood.

note.pt: Mais rara que o cedro comum.
note.en: Rarer than regular cedar.

note.pt: Trigo moido. Farinha e a base de metade da culinaria.
note.en: Ground wheat. Flour is the base of half the cooking recipes.

note.pt: Alternativa a farinha de trigo.
note.en: Alternative to wheat flour.

note.pt: Milho moido.
note.en: Ground corn.

note.pt: Batata moida.
note.en: Ground potato.

note.pt: Agua de rio filtrada. Insumo obrigatorio de quase toda alquimia.
note.en: Filtered river water. Mandatory input for almost all alchemy.

note.pt: A receita mais feita do jogo: alimenta os trabalhadores. O grao pode ser qualquer um, entao use o mais barato do dia.
note.en: The most crafted recipe in the game: it feeds workers. Any grain works, so use the cheapest of the day.

note.pt: Prato simples de carne.
note.en: Simple meat dish.

note.pt: Bom destino para peixe de pesca propria.
note.en: Good use for fish you caught yourself.

note.pt: Entra no Balenos Meal.
note.en: Goes into the Balenos Meal.

note.pt: Receita de varios ingredientes; entra no Balenos Meal.
note.en: Multi-ingredient recipe; goes into the Balenos Meal.

note.pt: Usa muito queijo; so vale com leite proprio.
note.en: Uses a lot of cheese; only worth it with your own milk.

note.pt: Buff de lifeskill muito usado. Leite vem de ordenha, nao do mercado.
note.en: Popular lifeskill buff. Milk comes from milking cows, not the market.

note.pt: Bebida de mel, usada em quests e buffs.
note.en: Honey drink, used in quests and buffs.

note.pt: Entra no Serendia Meal.
note.en: Goes into the Serendia Meal.

note.pt: Carne simples, boa para subir nivel de culinaria.
note.en: Simple meat dish, good for leveling cooking.

note.pt: Usa carne de ave de fazenda ou caca.
note.en: Uses bird meat from farms or hunting.

note.pt: Refeicao composta: feita de outros pratos. Buff de combate por 2 horas.
note.en: Composite meal: made from other dishes. Two-hour combat buff.

note.pt: Refeicao composta de Serendia.
note.en: Serendia composite meal.

note.pt: Refeicao de deserto, a mais cara de montar.
note.en: Desert meal, the most expensive to assemble.

note.pt: Reagente base da alquimia: 1 de cada ingrediente. Entra em quase todo elixir.
note.en: Base alchemy reagent: 1 of each ingredient. Goes into almost every elixir.

note.pt: O outro reagente base. Mesma estrutura do liquido claro.
note.en: The other base reagent. Same structure as the clear liquid one.

note.pt: Elixir de cura. Blood aceita varios tipos de sangue.
note.en: Healing elixir. Blood accepts several blood types.

note.pt: Elixir de recursos.
note.en: Resource elixir.

note.pt: Oleo base de varios elixires avancados. 1 de cada.
note.en: Base oil for several advanced elixirs. 1 of each.

note.pt: Buff de combate caro, muito usado em grind de endgame.
note.en: Expensive combat buff, heavily used in endgame grinding.

note.pt: Elixir de dano. Consome 5 reagentes por craft.
note.en: Damage elixir. Burns 5 reagents per craft.
